display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable name of the model group (for example, `Claude Sonnet 4.x`). For display only; it may change.

id.title: Id
id.description: Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.
